title: Wave-P K_p reference-frame recompute — does the partition double-count inflate Gate C.1?
premise_under_test: Occupancy = C/(C+Kd) requires C and Kd in the SAME reference frame. Vina's Kd is aqueous-1M-standard-state referenced (affinity_to_kd_uM: Kd=exp(dG/RT)*1e6). The comparator is the clinical AQUEOUS EC50. The shipped phase_c_occupancy line 152 sets conc_eff = Kp*conc_aq for membrane targets WITHOUT also scaling Kd, mixing frames. If both are scaled consistently the Kp cancels: (Kp*C)/(Kp*C + Kp*Kd) = C/(C+Kd). So the physically correct occupancy is the Kp-FREE one (M0); the shipped full-Kp (M2) over-counts. M1 (sqrt-Kp) is a bracketing intermediate.

models.M1_sqrt_Kp: partition exponent 0.5 for membrane_embedded targets only (bracketing).
models.M2_full_Kp: partition exponent 1.0 for membrane_embedded targets only = the SHIPPED model.

method: Reuse the FROZEN per-(anesthetic,gene) predicted_Kd_uM, ec50, Kp, compartment from artifacts/occupancy/best_pocket_per_target.csv. Recompute occupancy at halothane 1xEC50 under M0/M1/M2 by varying ONLY the partition factor (Kp**exp, applied to membrane_embedded targets exactly as the shipped code gates it). Do NOT re-dock, do NOT change Kd.
denominator_freeze: 30 halothane (gene) pairs = the realized Gate-C.1 panel (membrane_embedded 26, membrane_interfacial 2, aqueous_intracellular 2). Hash-locked. The 30-vs-32 Tier1 gap (NCA-1/UNC-80 missing structures) is the P13 hole, flagged not patched.

G_P11_1_engagement_survival.rule: Under M0 (correct frame), count halothane genes with occupancy > 0.10 at 1xEC50, and census saturation (occ > 0.90).
G_P11_1_engagement_survival.pass: n_M0(>10%) >= 5 AND saturation_M0 < saturation_M2 (the multi-target ENGAGEMENT survives the frame correction, while the saturating-occupancy magnitude was Kp-inflated).
G_P11_1_engagement_survival.deflate: n_M0(>10%) < 5 => the 30/30 multi-target headline was Kp-manufactured.
G_P11_1_engagement_survival.halt_methodological: if n_M0 == 30 AND saturation_M0 == saturation_M2 (still all saturated with NO Kp) => methodological error in the recompute, HALT and review.

G_P11_2_frame_fragility.fragile: spread >= 5 (the count itself depends on the partition frame)

G_P11_3_pseudo_test_screen.rule: Prove the gate is live on BOTH branches: >=1 halothane pair clears 10% under M0 (no Kp) AND >=1 pair that clears 10% ONLY because of Kp (i.e., M2>10% but M0<=10%). If the second set is empty, Kp changes nothing here and the deflation claim is vacuous; if the first is empty, M0 is trivially all-fail.
G_P11_3_pseudo_test_screen.pass: both non-empty OR explicitly reported empty with interpretation

claim_impact: The Wave-P sat_pa ladder is hand-set and DECOUPLED from Vina (phase_g_state_validator.py:24), so a P11 deflation does NOT flip any V1 network quorum/percentile — this is a MOLECULAR-LAYER honesty finding only. Expected: the >10% engagement count likely survives (EC50 ~ Kd magnitude, so occ ~0.25-0.5 >> 0.1 even without Kp), but the SATURATING occupancy (~0.99, 30/30) was a Kp double-count artifact; corrected magnitudes are moderate partial occupancy. Any 'saturating / maximal multi-target occupancy' language must be corrected to 'moderate partial occupancy'; the multi-target DISCRIMINATION claim stands.
anti_target_engineering: M0 designated decision-binding from the standard-state argument BEFORE the recompute; the >10% threshold and >=5 floor are the original Gate-C.1 values. A deflation (n_M0<5) is accepted; equally, a robust survival (the honest likely outcome) is reported as-is, including that it does NOT rescue the saturation magnitude.
